found_targets.title: setbidtobuy allows token purchase even when sale is no longer listed
found_targets.evidence: pub fn setbidtobuy(&mut self, token_id: String, amount: u64) -> Result<(), ContractError> { let mut token = self.get_token(&token_id).map_err(|_| ContractError::NotFound)?; if !token.sell.islisted.unwrap_or(false) { return Err(ContractError::NotListedForSale); } // ... (logic to add bid without checking approval or cleaning state) }

found_targets.title: Insufficient price validation in transfer_nft enables theft
found_targets.evidence: The transfer_nft function processes payments based on a bid amount found in token.bids, but it does not verify that the bid is valid for the current transfer. The payment amount is taken directly from the bid without ensuring the bid corresponds to a valid sale or rental, and the fee calculation is based on this unverified amount. This allows a user to transfer an NFT using a previously placed bid without proper validation, leading to potential theft of the bid amount.
